inputs.mese.nii.gz: 4D NIfTI [i, j, k, echo] magnitude images of a 3D CPMG multi-echo spin-echo scan (arbitrary units, Rician noise); echo n (1-based) at TE_n = n * EchoSpacing_s
inputs.labels.nii.gz: 3D NIfTI int16 region labels on the same grid (0 = background, 1..5 = regions of interest)
inputs.acquisition.json: EchoSpacing_s, EchoTime_s, NumberOfEchoes, ExcitationFlipAngle_deg, RefocusingFlipAngle_deg (nominal), RefocusingPhase, AssumedT1_s

conventions.pulses: non-selective rectangular (hard) pulses: one excitation of nominal ExcitationFlipAngle_deg followed by NumberOfEchoes refocusing pulses of nominal RefocusingFlipAngle_deg, spaced EchoSpacing_s apart with the first refocusing pulse at EchoSpacing_s/2; identical crusher gradients around every refocusing pulse, so the coherence pathways are those of the extended phase graph (EPG) description; no slice-profile effects
conventions.refocusing_phase: CPMG: every refocusing pulse is applied about an axis 90 degrees from the excitation axis
conventions.b1: the actual flip angle of every pulse is B1 * nominal, with a spatially smooth, unknown B1+ scale factor; inside the object 0.45 <= B1 <= 1.15 and B1 * RefocusingFlipAngle_deg never exceeds 180 degrees
conventions.relaxation: T2 between 0.03 and 0.26 s; tissue T1 is unknown but between 0.9 and 1.65 s and its effect is weak; use AssumedT1_s in the model
conventions.stimulated_echoes: because the refocusing flip angles differ from 180 degrees, the echo train is not a mono-exponential decay; T2 means the true transverse relaxation time of the tissue, not an apparent decay constant
conventions.noise: magnitude data with Rician noise; the noise level is not given

required_outputs: environment record (report.json 'software' object, or environment.txt / requirements.txt)
entrypoint_cli: python fit_t2.py --input-dir <dir> --output-dir <dir> . Reads mese.nii.gz, labels.nii.gz and acquisition.json from --input-dir and writes t2_map.nii.gz, b1_map.nii.gz and roi_t2.json to --output-dir. Standalone: helper code inside this one file; installed third-party imports allowed. It will be rerun on hidden data with the same file conventions but a different object, grid, affine, echo spacing, number of echoes, nominal refocusing angle and B1 field; read every protocol value from acquisition.json.

map_output_schema.t2_map.nii.gz: 3D float NIfTI, T2 in seconds, exactly the input grid and affine (values outside labels > 0 are not graded)
map_output_schema.b1_map.nii.gz: 3D float NIfTI, fitted B1+ scale (actual / nominal flip angle), same grid and affine

roi_output_schema.label_mean_T2_s: object mapping every nonzero label (as a string, e.g. "1") to the mean of t2_map over all voxels of that label, in seconds

grading_note: The grader compares the T2 and B1 maps and the label means with the ground truth, including the lowest-B1 voxels, and reruns fit_t2.py on the public data and on hidden data.
